text:
Priya - CSM: Heads up — proposing Nimbus pilot kickoff Mon 4/08 10:00am PT. Need to lock attendees (customer + their SEs), internal enablement lead, and a 30m live training. Also we should capture feedback cadence: weekly async check-ins + 2 live checkpoints during week 1 and week 4.
Liam - Onboarding: I can run the 30m training. Quick Q: do they use SSO? need their IdP type + SP metadata beforehand. Also will circulate a pre-kickoff checklist.
Eve - CS Ops: @Liam noted. Priya — do we have a short "what to expect" slide deck for pilot customers? If not I can draft a 6-slide version today.
Jordan - Eng: I'll join the first 20 mins to cover integration and common failure modes. Please flag rate-limit expectations and token quota we plan to enforce. Also can someone paste a minimal cURL smoke-test for their SEs?
Priya - CSM: Adding the cURL + pre-kickoff checklist below. Also asking Nimbus to provide 2 production-like prompts and one failing prompt so we can run a quick regression check during kickoff.
Priya - CSM: ```
# Smoke test
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-alpha-1","input":"Write a 2-sentence summary of the following text..."}'
```
Priya - CSM: Pre-kickoff checklist (short):
- Confirm SSO metadata + test account
- Share 2 sample prompts + 1 failing prompt
- Provide contact for infra/networking w/ port/IP allowlist
- Confirm expected daily qps and spike patterns
- Set success criteria for week 1 (latency, error rate, response quality)
reminders-bot: Calendar invite sent to nimbus-team@example.com and redwood-pilot@example.com — RSVP: 2/4.
Eve - CS Ops: I'll own the weekly survey and aggregate results. Plan: short Google form (3 questions: performance, accuracy, friction) + optional Loom for screenshots. I'll draft the template and share by EOD.
Liam - Onboarding: I'll prepare a short runbook for SSO and common token/quota errors. Will include links to the Console route for rate-limits and a snippet to generate a temporary test key.
Jordan - Eng: I'll add console alerts: token-exhaustion and 5xx spike rule with page escalation to eng-oncall. Also will create a tiny internal notebook to reproduce integration if they hit a crash.
Priya - CSM: Great — next steps: Eve to share survey + slide draft, Liam to share runbook, Jordan to add alerts. I'll finalize invite with agenda and attach the pre-kickoff checklist by EOD Friday. Thanks team :tada:
